about-developer.title: About developer
about-developer.longDescription: Hi, I am M. Rayen Sbai, a hobbyist Android developer from Tunisia. I started programming at the age of 14, and since then, I have been passionate about creating engaging apps and exploring new technologies. Currently, I am learning Unity to expand my skills in game development. With experience in React Native, Java, JavaScript, TypeScript and more, I enjoy building intuitive and functional applications.
